title: Filipino Roasted Bean Bowl
description: A delicious and healthy Filipino-inspired roasted bean bowl, perfect for a quick and easy lunch or dinner.

ingredients.name: Sprouts
ingredients.notes: Alfalfa or broccoli sprouts work well

instructions: In a bowl, toss the cooked kidney beans with olive oil, garlic, and soy sauce (if using).
Spread the beans on a baking sheet and roast in the oven for 20-25 minutes, or until lightly browned.
In a separate bowl, toss the sprouts with a pinch of salt and pepper.
Combine the roasted beans and sprouts in a serving bowl.
Season with additional salt and pepper to taste.
Serve warm, garnished with additional sprouts if desired.
